content.title: Chapter 38 - ENVIRONMENT — Sec. 38-125. - Penalty.
content.summary:
Creating, maintaining, or allowing a nuisance in violation of this article or in violation
               of
chapter 3
of the I.P.M.C. shall, for each offense, be punished by a fine, or imprisonment,
               or both, not to exceed the limits established in
section 1-5
of the Arvada City Code.…
